item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Alfred 6.0
item.description:
Long-standing productivity tool for macOS launchers

Alfred is a native productivity tool for macOS that integrates app launching, file finding, web searching, and daily automation into a simple keyboard search box. By customizing hotkeys and keywords, users can quickly open applications and folders, search browser bookmarks, local contacts, and past queries, and get results sorted in a way that better suits their usage habits. The clipboard history supports searching for and pasting text, images, file paths, and hexadecimal color codes. Automatic expansion of text snippets reduces the need to repeatedly enter frequently used content. With workflows, users can visually connect functional modules and combine multi-step operations. Developers can also use the Alfred UI to build native interfaces and custom layouts. The software also offers file previews, directory browsing, batch file operations, calculations, spell checking, system commands, music control, and terminal integration, and supports theme customization and synchronization of settings across multiple Macs. Some advanced features require Alfred Powerpack.

item.title: LiquidNotch 1.2.9
item.description:
Mac Dynamic Island Tool

LiquidNotch is a notch interaction tool for macOS that integrates notifications, music controls, volume and brightness indicators, file operations, and device status into the Mac notch area, transforming the previously static screen cutout into an information interface that expands and collapses with user actions. Notifications display the icon of the source app, support stacking, expanding for viewing, reviewing missed notifications, and allow direct replies to WhatsApp and Messages; The message body can also be hidden during screen sharing, and only the number of apps and notifications are displayed when the screen is locked. The app also provides an Atoll favorites portal, Shelf for temporarily storing text links and screenshots, DropZone for file transfers, media playback controls, Pomodoro timers, and battery level checks for headphones, mice, and keyboards. Teams meeting controls, Claude Code prompts, AI usage limits, incoming calls, Mac and iPhone battery levels, network connection, and Caps Lock status can also be displayed in the notch. LiquidNotch is compatible with macOS 14 Sonoma or later versions. When launched for the first time, it will explain the required system permissions one by one.

item.title: FrameOS 1.20
item.description:
macOS Screen Recording Software for Mobile Phones

FrameOS is a screen recording and video production tool for macOS 14 and later. It can connect to iPhones, iPads, or Android devices via USB to simultaneously record the device screen, camera, and microphone narration on a Mac. It also supports recording from iOS simulators or recording from the camera alone. The software integrates recording, editing, and exporting into a single workflow, making it ideal for creating app demos, how-to tutorials, game videos, product introductions, and issue reports. Users can set the screen orientation to landscape or portrait, or customize the canvas, and combine it with device frames, shadows, images, or looping video backgrounds. They can freely adjust the positions of the device, camera, and logo. After recording, you can trim pauses, zoom in on operation details, highlight key areas, add music and visual effects, and switch between how people and devices are displayed. On macOS 26 and later, you can also generate English subtitles through device-side speech transcription and modify the text and style. The software supports creating PNG screenshots with borders and annotations, exporting MOV files with transparent backgrounds, and saving scenes for later reuse.

item.title: AlbumLean 1.0.5
item.description:
macOS Photos Library Video Management

albumlean is a "Photos" library video management and storage cleanup tool for macOS. It sorts videos in descending order by their actual file size, helping users identify large video clips, screen recordings, and duplicate files that take up storage space on their Mac and iCloud. The software uses PhotoKit to read library metadata locally. There is no need to download the original files during the scan, and the results are displayed as the scan progresses. The space occupied is intuitively shown with size bars. Videos whose size cannot be obtained will be clearly marked and placed at the end. Users can browse by year and month, combine file name searches, filter by minimum size, and confirm items to be cleared by playing them within the app. They can also group suspected duplicate videos by the same number of bytes and choose to prioritize retaining favorited items or the earliest versions. The deletion operation requires confirmation. The video will be moved from "Photos" to "Recently Deleted" and can usually be restored within thirty days. After enabling iCloud Photos, deletions will be synced to other devices on the same account. The software also supports exporting original videos, favorites, keyboard shortcuts, and light and dark themes. No account is required, and no gallery data is uploaded. It is compatible with macOS 13 and later versions, and works with both Apple silicon and Intel Macs.

item.title: AgentDock 1.5.5
item.description:
macOSAI Programming Agent Management

AgentDock is an AI programming agent status management tool for macOS developers that displays Claude Code, Codex, and other terminal and desktop agents as status points at the edge of the screen, allowing you to quickly see which agents are working, waiting for a response, or have completed their tasks. Hover to view the model, branch, timer, and context, and click to jump to the corresponding session; Questions and permission requests from multiple agents are consolidated into a unified inbox and can be responded to using shortcuts, or by double-pressing the Option key in any application to send a message to a specific agent. Activity allows you to view agent work hours, completed sessions, models, sub-agents, wait times, and work during away periods on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis, and supports playback and desktop widgets. The software can also alert multiple agents when they are simultaneously modifying the same file, allow one agent to review another agent's work, and adjust the position, appearance, notifications, and grouping of status points through settings. AgentDock reads agent session files locally, without requiring an account or uploading data;

item.title: Pose 1.0.3
item.description:
Automated Mac App Screenshots

Pose is an automated screenshot tool for macOS app development and release processes. It uses repeatable scripts to drive apps natively and capture specified screens. Users can combine steps such as clicking, double-clicking, pressing keys, entering text, waiting for interface labels, selecting menus, and resizing windows in the visual editor, and save the results as screenshots of windows, parts of windows, or the entire screen. Each run starts from a consistent application state and demo data, generating images in the same order, making it easy to batch-refresh websites, documents, store pages, and demo materials after interface updates. Pose supports light and dark appearances, PNG, WebP, and JPEG formats, and allows you to set the background, shadows, desktop status, and launch parameters. Projects are saved as easy-to-read plain text pose files, which can be included in a code repository for version control and team review. During editing, you can also select interface labels from a running application, adjust windows, and select screenshot areas. All operations are performed offline on the Mac natively, without the need for an account or upload service. This is ideal for developers and teams who need to maintain consistent app screenshots over the long term.

item.title: Motty 0.4.14
item.description:
Native SSH Client for Mac

Motty is a native SSH client for macOS that integrates a terminal, SFTP file management, port forwarding, VNC and RDP remote desktops, and an AI assistant into a single window. It is ideal for server maintenance, remote development, and multi-host management. The software is built using the Go and Viva frameworks, does not rely on Electron or an embedded browser, and supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs. The terminal offers multiple tabs, horizontal and vertical split screens, history search, session recording, input broadcasting, and over 200 color schemes. It also allows you to view the processor, memory, disk, and network status of the remote host in the sidebar. The file panel supports recursive transfer, breakpoint resume, permission adjustment, and remote text editing, and can also follow the terminal directory. Hosts can be organized by groups and tags, and connection configurations can be imported from tools such as OpenSSH, PuTTY, and MobaXterm. The built-in AI assistant can answer questions based on the terminal context, execute commands after approval, and provide tools to external agents through an optional MCP interface.

item.title: EdgeMark 3.2.0
item.description:
macOS Sidebar Markdown Notes

EdgeMark is a native macOS sidebar Markdown note-taking app that resides in the menu bar and can be quickly summoned via the screen edge or a global shortcut key. It is ideal for jotting down notes, organizing information, and extracting content across applications. The frameless floating panel supports use across desktops and full-screen applications, offering auto-hide, fixed expansion, edge switching, multi-monitor adaptation, and width adjustment, with options for default, column, or card views. The editor is based on TextKit 2 and supports WYSIWYG Markdown editing, including tables, task lists, code blocks, bidirectional link syntax, inline images, and LaTeX formulas. It also features slash commands, formatting shortcuts, and find and replace functions to improve input efficiency. Notes are saved locally as standard .md files, with metadata stored separately. They can be opened using other editors, and you can choose your own synchronization and backup methods. The software offers multiple storage location switching, drag-and-drop folder organization, color-coded tag filtering, batch operations, hover previews, and auto-save. It can detect external file modifications and notify users when changes occur on both sides.

item.title: AirStats 1.7
item.description:
macOS Menu Bar System Monitor

AirStats is a lightweight menu bar system monitoring tool for macOS that centralizes the status of your entire system in a place you check daily. It supports the display of sixteen indicators. Users can choose to display only the two indicators they are most interested in, or they can view all the data at once. By clicking on the menu bar panel, users can also view detailed information about the load of each core, memory pressure, and processes with high resource usage. The monitoring scope covers the CPU, memory, GPU, network, disk, battery, temperature, and process information, and provides desktop widgets to keep the selected modules continuously displayed on the desktop. Users can set separate colors for different metrics or use a single-color interface to quickly identify the current status. AirStats will send a notification when a metric exceeds a custom threshold. The software supports keyboard shortcuts, allowing you to open the panel or desktop widgets without using the mouse. It runs as a single process, does not rely on auxiliary processes or launch agents, and does not remain in the background after exiting. The native data on the screen is read directly from the Mac, and relevant information is only sent out when a public IP query is enabled. The project is open source under the MIT License and currently supports Apple silicon chips and requires macOS 14 or later.

item.title: MacPacker 1.3.0
item.description:
QuickLook Browse and Extract Tool for macOS Compressed Packages

MacPacker is a native macOS archive management tool developed as open-source software and serves as an alternative to 7-Zip on Mac. It supports reading and extracting over 40 archive, disk image, and compression formats, including ZIP, RAR, 7z, TAR, DMG, ISO, and various compound archives. Users can view the contents of compressed archives just like browsing folders, without needing to fully extract them first. They can also access nested archives, view files through the system's built-in previewer, and drag and drop the files they need to the desired location, avoiding the need to extract an entire large archive for just a small amount of content. The software supports directly modifying and re-saving ZIP archives, and can also open password-protected and encrypted archives. With Quick Look and Finder extensions, users can preview archived content by pressing the spacebar or extract it to the current location and a specified folder via the right-click menu. The interface offers breadcrumb navigation, sortable lists, and keyboard shortcuts similar to Finder, and identifies file formats based on their characteristics rather than just their extensions.

item.title: iTerm2 3.7.8
item.description:
Powerful terminal simulator

iTerm2 is a powerful terminal emulator that provides more terminal operation functions and experiences on macOS systems for professionals such as developers and system administrators. There are split windows, searches, command smart tips plus autocomplete, history, fully definable terminal skin styles, and more. iTerm2 supports multiple tabs and screens, allowing users to run multiple terminals at the same time in the same window, eliminating the need to switch windows frequently and improving productivity. iTerm2 also supports a variety of terminal window appearance configurations, including color schemes, fonts, font sizes, etc. Users can adjust according to their preferences to make the terminal interface more beautiful and comfortable. iTerm2 has a powerful built-in search function that supports searching for historical commands, text, and other content in the terminal, making it easy for users to find and locate relevant information. In addition, iTerm2 supports terminal plug-ins that help users quickly access commonly used commands and tools, such as zsh, tmux, and more.

item.title: Switch 0.3.24
item.description:
Window-level ⌘Tab switcher for macOS

Switch is a window switcher for macOS that changes the usual ⌘-Tab behavior from app-level to window-level cycling. Use ⌘-Tab to go forward, ⇧⌘Tab to go back, and ⌥-` to cycle windows within an app, including across multiple Spaces. Windows appear in a vertical list you can filter by typing. A Sticky mode lets you preview a window without committing to the switch, and shortcuts let you close a window (⌘W), quit an app (⌘Q) or hide it (⌘H). It is free, open source, notarized, and requires macOS 14 or later.

item.title: AppPorts 2.3.0
item.description:
Mac Migration Assistant

AppPorts is an application migration and storage management tool designed specifically for macOS. Its core capability is to migrate large applications to an external hard drive or external storage with a single click, while retaining a minimal placeholder file locally, allowing the application to still appear in /Applications, Launchpad, and the macOS menu as before and launch normally. It employs an intelligent linking mechanism to minimize local disk usage while maintaining a consistent system experience. It also offers features such as automatic update protection, code signing management, detection of orphaned links after disconnecting external drives, automatic recovery from migration interruptions, and the ability to revert to local storage at any time. This makes it suitable for users who need to free up Mac storage space without disrupting their usage habits. AppPorts is an application migration and storage management tool for macOS. It can migrate large applications and data directories to external storage while minimizing the impact on the system user experience, and keep the local launch path consistent with the daily operating method.

item.title: Lyrimuse 1.14.0
item.description:
Elegant macOS desktop lyrics tool

Lyrimuse is an open-source desktop lyrics app for macOS. It resides in the menu bar and highlights lyrics word by word as songs play. It displays content via floating desktop widgets, Dynamic Island-style capsules, the menu bar, the Touch Bar, or a separate lyrics window. It supports 20 music players, including Apple Music, Spotify, QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Kugou, Soda Music, and Luxue Music. It can also connect to YouTube Music and the web version of Spotify in your browser, automatically scoring and selecting matching results from 15 lyric sources. The software provides lyric translations, Cantonese romanization, Japanese kana, and romanizations in multiple languages. It supports simplified-to-traditional Chinese conversion, local lyric import, song-by-song time correction, and offline display of cached lyrics. Users can customize fonts, colors, backgrounds, and layouts, hide lyrics when taking screenshots, recording screens, and sharing screens, and send lyrics to LAN devices or use them as an OBS transparent browser source.

item.title: PasteMemo 1.18.0
item.description:
Lightweight Native Clipboard Manager

PasteMemo is a lightweight, native macOS clipboard manager that runs as a resident menu bar app. It captures everything the user copies and enables instant search and pasting anywhere. The software supports quick panel operations, allowing users to open a feature-rich clipboard workstation via global hotkeys to perform various advanced operations such as searching, filtering by application or group, entering slash commands, pasting text as files, and pasting paths. PasteMemo introduces clipboard automation, allowing users to define rules based on regular expressions, content types, or sources. This enables automatic actions such as cleaning tracking URLs, assigning groups, flagging sensitive content, and removing formatting, making the clipboard work intelligently in the background. The software offers a custom grouping feature, allowing users to manually assign items by right-clicking or automatically categorize them through automation rules. This enables the organized arrangement of code snippets, links, colors, and other content into different groups, with color-coding for easy differentiation.

item.title: LanFi 5.4.0
item.description:
macOS Open Source WiFi Analysis Tool

LanFi is a native macOS Wi-Fi analysis tool that scans nearby wireless networks based on the Apple CoreWLAN framework, transforming signal strength, signal-to-noise ratio, channel overlap, utilization, and security configurations into interpretable quality scores to help users determine connection status and troubleshoot wireless network issues. The software supports Wi-Fi 4 to Wi-Fi 7 recognition, providing 2. 4, 5, and 6 GHz frequency band charts and sorted channel suggestions can detect risks related to open network, WEP, legacy WPA, WPS, and management frame protection, and give severity and repair tips. The built-in diagnostic engine covers wireless links, IPv4 and IPv6, gateways, DNS, portal authentication, HTTPS, and latency checking in conjunction with signal history and continuous monitoring for location failures. Users can also view underlying protocol fields, analyze offline packet capture files, collect data through SSH remote sensors, import floorplans to generate signal heatmaps, and manage survey results using groupings, tags, notes, and saved sessions.

item.title: WailBrew 0.15.0
item.description:
Homebrew Graphical Interface Management Tool

WailBrew is a sleek and minimalist Homebrew package management graphical user interface (GUI) designed for macOS, making the use of command-line tools intuitive and modern. Users can easily install, update, and uninstall software packages with just a few simple clicks, without having to memorize complex commands or deal with terminal syntax. Built on the solid foundation of Homebrew, WailBrew offers a secure operation process and comprehensive error handling to ensure smooth package management. It supports real-time filtering and detailed information searches, helping users manage thousands of formulas and cask applications. WailBrew is not only suitable for ordinary users who prefer graphical interfaces, but also provides developers with a way to install via the Homebrew command line, demonstrating its practicality and flexibility. WailBrew makes Homebrew's powerful features even easier to use through a beautiful interface. WailBrew is a minimalist and visually appealing graphical user interface (GUI) for Homebrew package management. It offers macOS users an intuitive and modern operating experience, making the powerful capabilities of command-line tools easily accessible.

item.title: Dayflow 2.9.5
item.description:
Screen timeline backtracking tool

Dayflow is an automatic work log and time tracking tool running on macOS. It quietly collects lightweight screen clips in the background. Combined with the artificial intelligence model you choose, it organizes the original screen activities into activity cards and timelines arranged by time, so you can look back at what you really did in a day without a timer or manual notes. It focuses not on a simple window title or front-end app name, but on the specific work that is happening on the screen, so developing features, troubleshooting problems, reviewing merge requests in a code editor, or retrieving data and communicating collaborations in a browser, chat tool, are all written as contextual summaries. The daily station view pulls yesterday's highlights, today's priorities, and roadblocks from the timeline to help you quickly prepare for updates, while the weekly review summarizes focus patterns, time distribution, key applications, and factors that keep you off task. You can also ask for records with periods of one day, one week, or more in natural language, and export timelines for any date range as Markdown for status synchronization, customer notes, or personal review.

item.title: UTM 5.0.9-2
item.description:
macOS Open Source Free Virtual Machine

UTM is a powerful virtualization software that leverages the popular QEMU system emulator to securely run various operating systems in a sandboxed environment, protecting user data from viruses and malware. It is specifically designed for macOS Big Sur and later versions, taking full advantage of Apple's latest technologies. By combining powerful features with a user-friendly experience, UTM is the ideal choice for Mac users to virtualize and emulate operating systems. Whether for development, testing, or simply experiencing an operating system, UTM can meet users' needs. Run ARM64 operating systems: UTM supports fully virtualized operation of operating systems such as Windows 10 ARM and Ubuntu ARM on Apple Silicon Macs at near-native speeds. Intel/AMD operating system emulation: Allows Windows 7, Windows XP, Ubuntu, and other operating systems to run in emulation mode with limited performance on Apple Silicon Macs, while full virtualization is possible on Intel Macs.

item.title: Canopy v2 1.2.1
item.description:
macOS Dynamic Island Enhancer

Canopy 2 is a dynamic Dynamic Island enhancement tool for macOS that transforms the Mac's notch area or the space at the top of the screen into an information display and media control center, allowing notifications, music, videos, device status, and weather information to be presented in a more natural way. It supports the display of AirPods battery level and connection status, and allows you to view playback information, album covers, playback controls, and progress sliders for Spotify and Apple Music in the Dynamic Island. It can also handle the playback status of video platforms such as Netflix and Twitch. The software also provides time-synchronized lock screen lyrics, charging animations, low battery reminders, and real-time weather information. It is compatible with external monitors and Macs without a notch design, making it suitable for use with various combinations of desktops and devices. Canopy 2 focuses on being lightweight and efficient, minimizing resource usage and not interfering with daily workflows. A single license can activate up to three Macs, and users can manage, remove, or edit verified devices at any time, making notification browsing, media operations, and system status viewing more centralized, intuitive, and visually expressive.

item.title: Vibe Island 1.0.56
item.description:
Notch Dynamic Island AI Agent Control Tool

Vibe Island is a native macOS app designed specifically for Mac, which transforms the Dynamic Island or top notch area of a MacBook into a real-time control center for AI coding agents. Users can maintain a state of flow while multiple AI agents such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Google Gemini CLI, Cursor Agent, OpenCode, and Factory Droid are running simultaneously. Through the gap, they can directly monitor agent progress, review execution plans, approve permission requests, or quickly switch to the corresponding terminal without frequently switching windows. The application supports over 13 terminals, including iTerm2, Ghostty, Warp, and Terminal. The app, along with the built-in terminals of VS Code and Cursor, can precisely locate specific tabs and split screens, and supports tmux sessions. Vibe Island is developed entirely in Swift. It is lightweight, uses less than 50 MB of memory, consumes almost no CPU resources when running, and does not steal focus from the editor as an inactive overlay.

item.title: FFWorks 5.4.7
item.description:
Professional Video Format Converter

ff·Works is a professional video conversion and media processing tool for macOS. Built around FFmpeg's graphical interface, it enables users to perform high-quality transcoding, containerization, editing, and batch processing without the need to write command lines. It supports a wide range of audio and video formats and encoders, including H264, H265, AV1, ProRes, DNxHD, VP9, AAC, FLAC, etc., and offers 4K, 5K, and 8K ultra-high-definition output capabilities. The software includes built-in features such as color adjustment, cropping, overlay, watermark, subtitles, merging, filters, bitrate analysis, quality indicator detection, and thumbnail contact sheet generation. It is suitable for both general users to quickly apply presets for iPhone, Apple TV, YouTube, TikTok, etc., and for advanced users to finely control encoding quality, file size, and playback compatibility through hundreds of parameters. ff·Works 5 is a graphical video converter for macOS that integrates complex command-line transcoding processes into an intuitive interface, making it suitable for high-quality video conversion, batch processing, format encapsulation, subtitle processing, image adjustment, and professional encoding optimization.

item.title: SaneHosts 1.1.28
item.description:
Hosts Ad Blocker Management Tool

SaneHosts is a local hosts file protection tool for macOS that uses system-level hosts rules to block known ads, trackers, telemetry domains, malicious sites, and distracting content, providing consistent protection for Safari, Chrome, Slack, games, and other applications. It stores hosts data locally and does not rely on VPNs, cloud accounts, or browser extensions, making it suitable for Mac users who value privacy and transparency. The software comes with multiple one-click protection levels, ranging from basic ad tracking blocking to family safety, focus mode, privacy protection, and more aggressive full blocking, and supports selected rules from sources such as StevenBlack, Hagezi, and AdGuard. Users can create multiple profiles, import local files or URLs, and merge, copy, and batch-manage entries; The DNS cache is automatically flushed each time the configuration is enabled or switched, and modifications to the system hosts file are authorized via macOS Touch ID or password, while retaining a backup for rollback.

item.title: Fluent 2.3.10
item.description:
Flexible AI writing tool

Fluent is a powerful AI writing assistant designed to improve users' writing efficiency and quality. As flexible as Spotlight, it can work in any application to help users with a variety of tasks, such as translation, grammar correction, drafting emails and social media posts, and extracting key points. Fluent supports users in using their own cloud AI API keys (such as OpenAI, Gemini, and OpenRouter) and offers over 320 OpenRouter models, as well as various local AI models that can be loaded directly from a Mac, ensuring data security. Users can customize hotkeys and actions, use over 30 preset default actions, and preview results in real time through the smart panel, including Markdown rendering. Fluent prioritizes privacy, does not collect user data, and supports fully offline work. It is a tool designed specifically to enhance writing productivity. Fluent Mac is a powerful AI writing assistant designed to improve your writing efficiency and quality. It offers a wide range of features, including translation, grammar correction, and drafting of emails and social media posts, and can seamlessly integrate into any application you are using.

item.title: DockFlow 1.95
item.description:
Mac Dock Grouping Layout Tool

DockFlow is a workspace switching tool designed specifically for Mac users. It aims to help users quickly create and switch between different dock icon combinations to suit various work scenarios. Users simply set the desired application and folder icons and can easily switch to a custom dock layout via keyboard shortcuts or menu bar icons, improving work efficiency. DockFlow supports adding a variety of items, including folders, files, and URL links, to facilitate one-click access to commonly used resources. DockFlow allows users to set icon intervals, reasonably layout icons, and supports exporting and importing personalized configurations for easy system migration or sharing. With DockFlow, users can quickly adapt to different workflows, eliminating the distractions of context switching and allowing them to focus more on their work. DockFlow is a program dock switching tool designed for macOS users to simplify workspace management and help users quickly create and switch between different combinations of Dock icons to suit different work scenarios. With a one-time setup, DockFlow offers lifelong productivity gains.

item.title: CrewTower 1.0.43
item.description:
Lingdong Island AI Agent Request Approval

CrewTower is a native AI agent session management tool for macOS users that centralizes tasks from desktop applications, editors, and terminals such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, and opencode into a floating capsule at the top of the Mac or on other displays. Users can view task progress, context usage, running status, completion reminders, and requests that need to be processed without frequently switching windows. They can also directly approve or reject supported commands, answer questions, select solutions, review plans, and submit feedback. For dangerous operations, CrewTower displays clear warnings and provides options such as one-time, current session, or always allow. Jump takes the user back to an accurate app window, tab, terminal window, panel, or tmux pane.

item.title: TabBarForOffice 2.3.1
item.description:
Microsoft Office Tab Quick Switch Assistant

TabBar for Office is an Office file tab management tool for Mac that provides an intuitive tab bar for currently open files in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, reducing the need to repeatedly search between multiple separate windows and window menus. The software automatically switches the displayed content based on the foreground Office application, presenting documents, workbooks, or presentations as separate tabs. You can switch between them by clicking, and the currently viewed file is marked accordingly. The tab bar is fixed to follow the foreground Office window. You can drag the right edge to adjust its width, and each application can remember its own settings. You can also close the tab bar of a specific application as needed. The software runs through the menu bar, does not display a Dock icon, does not add an interface within Office applications, and supports optional login startup as well as interfaces in English, German, Spanish, and Hebrew. It only reads the names of open files and switches to the corresponding windows. It does not read file contents, modify files, or send data, and no registration or login is required. Automation permissions for the relevant Office applications must be granted when using the software for the first time;

item.title: TabBarForExcel 2.3.1
item.description:
Excel Workbook Tab Management

TabBar is a native Office productivity tool for macOS that adds an intuitive document tab bar to Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. The software displays the currently open documents, workbooks, and presentations as a row of tabs above the window. Clicking on a tab brings the corresponding file to the foreground, eliminating the need to repeatedly open the window menu, access Mission Control, or search through the file list. The tab bar moves and resizes with the currently active Office window, always docking above the window and avoiding obstructing content. Its width can be adjusted by dragging, up to 80% of the screen width, and it remembers the last setting. The tab bar only appears when Word, Excel, or PowerPoint is in focus. It automatically hides when you leave Office, and you can also manually show or hide it using keyboard shortcuts. TabBar runs from the system menu bar, does not display a separate window or Dock icon, and does not install add-ins in Office. It supports on-demand settings to launch after login.

item.title: TabBarForPowerPoint 2.3.1
item.description:
PowerPoint Multi-Window Management

TabBar is a productivity tool for the Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Supplemental Documents tab bar for macOS that displays the currently open collection of documents, workbooks, and presentations above the active window, quickly switching files by clicking on the tab, eliminating the need to repeatedly expand the window menu, use the Dispatch Center, or find files in a list. The tab bar automatically follows the active Office window, fits when you move or resize the window, appears only when the app is in focus, and automatically hides when you leave Office to reduce distractions to your desktop space. The user can drag the handle on the right to adjust the width of the tab bar, the settings will be preserved at the next start, and the shortcut keys can be used to quickly display or collapse. The software resides in the menu bar, does not occupy a docking location, does not install plug-ins to Office, and supports on-demand setup login startup. It reads only the name of the open file and places the selected window in the foreground, without reading, modifying or uploading the content of the document, without registering an account or logging in.

item.title: Bezel 5.5.1
item.description:
iPhone Wireless Mirroring Tool

Bezel is an ultimate wireless iPhone mirroring tool designed for Mac, developed by the Nonstrict team. It can instantly mirror any iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Vision Pro, or even iPod Touch to Mac via AirPlay wireless or USB wired connection. It supports different iCloud accounts, automatic rotation and device matching, true physical size or pixel-perfect display, always-on-top pinning, sleep/lock status detection, custom bezel color, and automatic adaptation. Perfect for presentations, screen recording, and showcasing. It offers one-click high-definition screen recording and screenshots with authentic borders and backgrounds (the Pro version removes watermarks and provides unlimited recording time). It features full-screen, distraction-free immersive display, synchronized audio transmission, and a guided connection process for new devices. The interface is natively smooth and lightweight, making it a favorite among product managers, designers, developers, and content creators. It is hailed as the ultimate iPhone screen-casting tool that far surpasses QuickTime, allowing content within the phone to be seamlessly displayed on a computer. Content sharing, team presentations, application demonstrations, and recording experiences become seamlessly impressive.

item.title: BetterMacWidgets 2.17.0
item.description:
macOS High Face Desktop Widget

BetterMacWidgets is a desktop widget tool for macOS 15 and above running on Apple Silicon Mac that places weather, music playback, system status, to-dos, notes, clocks, world time, calendars, photos, cryptocurrencies, web traffic, Bluetooth devices, app launchers, shortcuts, timers, stopwatches, unit converters, and password generators directly on the desktop. The software provides 25 widgets and 20 themes, supports free drag and drop and invisible snap meshes, so that widgets of different sizes are neatly arranged; weather supports real-time forecasting and custom cities, music widgets can connect Spotify or Apple Music and playback control, and photo widgets can read specific folders and play dynamic slides. The liquid glass exterior supports transparent suspension and adjustable frosting, and the Pro version also offers the same size widget stacking, desktop layout configuration, cross-monitor adaptation, and automatic switching by time, front-end application, or connected display.

item.title: Floodtide 1.6.2
item.description:
App updater for macOS

Floodtide is an app updater for macOS that reads the latest version information from each app's own Sparkle update feed and from the Homebrew catalog, then scans supported apps and updates them in bulk. It needs no hand-maintained app database and no Homebrew installation, and it checks official downloads and checksums published by developers. Apps whose update source can't be verified are listed clearly rather than guessed at. It offers one-click Update All, automatic backup before updating, undo of recent updates within seven days, and checks of code signature, Gatekeeper results and developer team before installing. It supports macOS 13 or later on Intel and Apple Silicon, keeps its app list on your Mac, and needs no account or special permissions.
